title: Ryan Garcia defeats Conor Benn by TKO in welterweight title defense
summary: Ryan Garcia successfully defended his WBC welterweight title by defeating Conor Benn via a second-round technical knockout (TKO) in Las Vegas. Garcia's victory was decisive, with Benn being outclassed and ultimately stopped by the champion. Following the fight, Benn was taken to the hospital. Benn later broke his silence about the defeat, and Chris Eubank Jr. made a public comment about Benn's performance.
summary_points: Ryan Garcia defeated Conor Benn by second-round TKO.
Garcia successfully defended his WBC welterweight title.
Conor Benn was taken to the hospital after the fight.
Benn later commented on his defeat.
Chris Eubank Jr. made a public remark about Benn's loss.

summary_hi: रयान गार्सिया ने लास वेगास में कॉनर बेन को दूसरे दौर के टेक्निकल नॉकआउट (टी.के.ओ.) से हराकर अपने डब्ल्यू.बी.सी. वेल्टरवेट खिताब का सफलतापूर्वक बचाव किया। गार्सिया की जीत निर्णायक थी, जिसमें बेन को चैंपियन द्वारा मात दी गई और अंततः रोका गया। लड़ाई के बाद, बेन को अस्पताल ले जाया गया। बेन ने बाद में हार पर अपनी चुप्पी तोड़ी, और क्रिस यूबैंक जूनियर ने बेन के प्रदर्शन पर एक सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी की।
